title: Congruent splits with geometric prices and null-circuit clearing: conditional κ = 5.2445080818074e-5
body:
## Conditional improvement over #87

**κ = 26222540409037/500000000000000000 = 5.2445080818074×10⁻⁵**, approximately **0.0250263% above PR #87** (52431959054651/10^18), under the inherited analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses. Bit saving: **52447831448991/10^18**.

Combine **@gupt1156's #87 congruent `[4,4,1]` splits** with **#86 final-coordinate pricing**, **@alejandrozu's #75 null-circuit clearing idea**, and bounded two/three-carrier exchanges. Null relations let the compiler substitute a cheaper legal clearing expression; every actual XOR and frame raise remains paid. The selected runs accept four and two three-carrier exchanges, respectively.

| Quantity | #87 | This |
|---|---:|---:|
| h23 auxiliary roles | 26705 | **26695** |
| h25 auxiliary roles | 35137 | **35132** |
| Physical width | 131795727 | **131763872** |
| Total recursive rank | 75780696125 | **75762379500** |

The eight cloud experiments all passed. Exact full-profile comparison included all their axis combinations plus 48 independently tested coordinate-only alternatives. No global-optimality, exact weighted-matching, unconditional-theorem or practical-speed claim is made.

## Live comparison

At publication, PR #88 reports κ = 5.2514124198891e-5 and the updated PR #74 (`428b5c167686b42a83f1abf7003c6d17aec561ea`) reports κ = 5.278214423139e-5. Both exceed this witness. The comparison above is specifically against pinned #87; this is not a current-record claim.

## Validation

**Full repository verification passed; ready for review.** Both dimensions pass scalar checks, complete arbitrary-dirty physical replay in both orientations, fresh CRT profiles with zero disagreements, independent exact moment bounds, next-grid rejection, 47 strict constraints and seven margins. The complete #87 child list is excluded at the new saving.

Nine focused tests include four adversarial actual-source null-circuit cases, four carrier-exchange controls, derived-source byte hashes, coordinate inversion, omitted charges, stale width/exponent and optimized-Python rejection. Independent local regeneration also passed in 240.771 seconds: both words matched the cloud outputs byte-for-byte, fresh physical profiles and exact arithmetic passed, and all nine controls passed again. Full `make -j1 verify`, parent and new compiler regenerations, seven inherited controls and nine new controls passed in 3367.923 seconds (56m 8s), including 84 isolated test modules and 20 historical patch checks, on research commit `b2df9de3147006cb6a652e5409ce2f44bbd71926`. There was no source drift. All 48 GitHub checks passed on the tested research commit; the subsequent commit adds only the validation receipt and documentation. The committed `research/congruent-geometric-pricing/validation.json` records exact commands, timing and evidence hashes. The 608-file source closure pins the graph, configurations, compiler derivation, physical words, profiles, proofs and checks.

```sh
python3 research/congruent-geometric-pricing/verify.py --regenerate
python3 research/congruent-geometric-pricing/test_controls.py
make verify
```

`PROOF.md` explains general grouping contraction, kernel-expression invariance, frame eligibility and paid physical execution. Inherited all-size compiler, scalar/routing/recovery, finite-alphabet multitape and analytic-transfer obligations remain explicit. No topological cancellation theorem is claimed.
